mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains near its current level after a sharp earlier rebound, commuter-driven discretionary trips stabilize and RETAIL_REC stays above the prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages below the last 28-day mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES holding within 5 points of t-0w for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further weekly drop in TRANSIT below the recent floor suppresses in-person shopping trips within one week, pushing RETAIL_REC lower than its last-four-week average.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -42 and stays there for a week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the last 28-day mean within 7 days of TRANSIT crossing below -42.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL is elevated while PARKS remain depressed, people substitute toward local errands and indoor retail rather than leisure mobility, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays below -25 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise above its last-28-day mean within 14 days when PARKS remains below -25 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +4.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed workplace reopening, seen as a continued rise in WORKPLACES from the current trough, creates more weekday foot traffic and increases RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by at least 5 points week-on-week from its latest value
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below the prior 28-day average over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES rises by at least 5 points in a week.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays positive while RETAIL_REC remains weak, households are already out for essential trips, and the residual shift into retail-and-recreation is limited, keeping RETAIL_REC flat to lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its last 28-day mean over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in PARKS and TRANSIT signals warmer-weather or outdoor-activity substitution that shifts demand away from retail venues, lowering RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -20 and TRANSIT rises above -35
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to its last 28-day mean within 14 days after both PARKS and TRANSIT cross the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During tightening restrictions, a persistent gap between low WORKPLACES and low TRANSIT suppresses shopping trips and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above the prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain at least 10 points below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL eases from its current elevated level while TRANSIT does not worsen further, more time spent outside the home translates into a gradual rebound in retail-and-recreation visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls by at least 1 point from its latest weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last 28-day mean over the next 28 days even after RESIDENTIAL declines and TRANSIT remains within 5 points of its current level.
